DOOMSCROLLING / THE HIDDEN COST
Night-time digital media use is associated with shorter sleep and poorer sleep quality. Doomscrolling is also associated with psychological distress and lower wellbeing. Most evidence is observational—association is not causation.
textPreview: DOOMSCROLLING / THE HIDDEN COST | Night-time digital media use is associated with shorter sleep and poorer sleep quality. Doomscrolling i...

text:
The strongest defensible takeaway is not that every scroll causes harm. It is that habitual, especially night-time, use is repeatedly associated with poorer sleep and wellbeing.

[Sources]
- https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36638702/
- https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36275044/
[/Sources]
